scope: Current working-tree parser declarations/cases and option contracts, identified by content hashes. Not a pre-migration benchmark or behavioral certification.

parserDeclarations.name: options
parserDeclarations.expression:
{
    command,
    cascade: false,
    final: false,
    apply: false,
    yes: false,
    json: false,
    jsonl: false,
    continueSession: false,
    implicitCommand: true
  }

parserDeclarations.name: commands
parserDeclarations.expression: {agents: {list: 0, create: 1, tools: 1, start: 0, select: 1, rename: 2, model: 2, discard: 0, delete: 1}, connections: {list: 0, configure: 1, use: 1}, projects: {list: 0, context: 0, open: 2, select: 1}}

parserDeclarations.name: counts
parserDeclarations.expression: { list: [1, 1], capture: [3, 22], inspect: [1, 1], prepare: [1, 1], review: [1, 1], apply: [2, 2], recover: [2, 2], storage: [0, 0], 'prune-review': [1, 100], 'prune-apply': [2, 101] }

parserDeclarations.name: counts
parserDeclarations.expression: { remember: 1, list: 0, read: 1, update: 3, forget: 2, suggest: 1, accept: 2, clear: 0, enable: 0, disable: 0, context: 1 }

optionBranches.statements:
options.projectMemory = false;
break;

options.updateProfile = true;
break;

positional.push(argument);
break;

options.unlimitedTokens = false;
break;

options.unlimitedTokens = true;
break;

options.projectContext = false;
break;

options.requireVerifiedDelivery = true;
break;

options.yes = true;
break;

options.json = true;
break;

options.jsonl = true;
break;

options.continueSession = true;
break;

options.cascade = true;
break;

options.final = true;
break;

options.apply = true;
break;

options.command = "help";
break;

options.command = "version";
break;

commandBranches.statements: throw new CliUsageError(`Invalid ${options.command} action or arguments. See zhx help ${options.command}.`);
throw new CliUsageError('agents tools requires - to read module JSON from stdin.');
throw new CliUsageError('connections configure requires - to read provider JSON from stdin.');
options.command = "chat";
throw new CliUsageError('application lifecycle commands operate on the whole host, not one area.');
throw new CliUsageError('This command does not yet support application mode.');
throw new CliUsageError('--session for checkpoints requires --service or application mode.');

parserDeclarations.name: options
parserDeclarations.expression:
{
    command,
    cascade: false,
    final: false,
    apply: false,
    yes: false,
    json: false,
    jsonl: false,
    continueSession: false,
    implicitCommand: true
  }

parserDeclarations.name: counts
parserDeclarations.expression: { remember: 1, list: 0, read: 1, update: 3, forget: 2, suggest: 1, accept: 2, clear: 0, enable: 0, disable: 0, context: 1 }

optionBranches.statements:
options.projectMemory = false;
break;

options.updateProfile = true;
break;

positional.push(argument);
break;

options.unlimitedTokens = false;
break;

options.unlimitedTokens = true;
break;

options.projectContext = false;
break;

options.requireVerifiedDelivery = true;
break;

options.yes = true;
break;

options.json = true;
break;

options.jsonl = true;
break;

options.continueSession = true;
break;

options.cascade = true;
break;

options.final = true;
break;

options.apply = true;
break;

options.command = "help";
break;

options.command = "version";
break;

commandBranches.statements: options.command = "chat";
throw new CliUsageError("Project memory requires the matched next-version Harness engine. See the project memory migration guide.");
